branch_guards: No historical Truk alert stand-down after a single negative search.
No US-style Japanese GCI; radar/plot provides coarse sector/vector and staged readiness only.
Water aviation is an independent reconnaissance/recontact layer; it is not hidden inside runway-aircraft totals.
No first-line Japanese carrier reversal toward Truk; carrier aircrew debt from 2-Feb remains binding.
High-value ship evacuation is limited by seaworthiness, escort, fuel, route risk and repair state; not every hull can escape.

water_aviation_independent.mix: older float reconnaissance / flying-boat or long-range water reconnaissance, Kyofu already counted where acting as fighter, and a small Zuiun-class fast-confirmation element
water_aviation_independent.guard: Do not add this pool again to fighter totals where Kyofu is already counted.

Truk_air_state_19Feb_evening.nonessential_transit_aircraft: Most flyable transit/ferry aircraft are sent west or dispersed before raid dawn; damaged/non-flyable airframes may remain as maintenance liabilities.

Truk_sensor_AA_state.warning_network: A-grade radar + visual + RI/DF + weather + plot + radio/telephone + water-air/search integration with physically separated power/spares where available.
Truk_sensor_AA_state.light_AA: numerous local barrels; useful against low-level attacks but constrained by ammunition, arcs, target identification and saturation.
Truk_sensor_AA_state.preparedness: AA fully manned through the final night; fighters use layered ready states instead of mass ground parking.

warning_timeline.action: continue evacuation, disperse fuel/ammunition/aircraft, inspect backup power and alternate communications; no peacetime stand-down

warning_timeline.state: major US carrier sortie HIGH; Truk target MEDIUM-HIGH
warning_timeline.action: search sectors shift east/northeast; nonessential aircraft and mobile high-value ships receive priority westward movement

warning_timeline.state: westbound fast-heavy force HIGH; Truk primary/co-primary HIGH
warning_timeline.action: sustained fighter/AA alert; 5-7 submarine/route warning nodes with only 2-4 favorably placed for direct carrier contact

warning_timeline.state: attack within 12-36h HIGH; exact launch sector MEDIUM
warning_timeline.action: all-night alert, layered CAP readiness, final merchant/auxiliary evacuation attempt, no blind large night strike

mobile_evacuation_center.Hiryu: Emergency repair reaches safe self-propelled/ferry-recovery state; departs Truk westward centered 14-15 Feb, without waiting for full combat restoration.
mobile_evacuation_center.Shokaku_Zuikaku_Soryu: remain westward; do not return to Truk defense.
mobile_evacuation_center.Akashi_mobile_repair: priority emergency work completed; departs centered 16-17 Feb.
mobile_evacuation_center.fleet_oilers_major_tenders: most high-value mobile units depart 11-18 Feb.
mobile_evacuation_center.last_convoy: 5-8 merchant/auxiliary hulls plus about 2 escorts attempt departure evening/night 19 Feb; route varies west/southwest.

preemptive_strike_gate: NO-GO: warning is sufficient for defense and evacuation but carrier position remains too stale/uncertain for a large positive-EV Japanese preemptive strike.
